---
name: sharing-and-storage
description: Evaluate safe, practical storage and collaboration choices for shareable garden plans.
---

# Sharing and storage

- Treat free storage as a product constraint to investigate, not as a preselected vendor or an unlimited guarantee. Record relevant limits, retention, export, availability, and operational tradeoffs.
- Clarify what is shared (plan, plant records, notes, and/or photos), who can access it, how access is granted or revoked, and what collaborators may change.
- Default to private plans unless the user has explicitly chosen otherwise. Do not expose a plan through an unguessable URL alone without clarifying the intended access model.
- Consider sign-in, ownership, invitations or links, authorization checks, concurrent edits, deletion, and recovery only to the extent required by the ticket.
- Keep user content portable where practical; document storage and provider lock-in tradeoffs.
- Ask the user to decide material product tradeoffs rather than silently selecting a provider, permission model, or ongoing cost.
